approved_upstream_decisions_reused_exact.decision: P3 freezes T1/T2/T3/T4 inputs/oracles, MBT model, budgets, seeds, resets, union, denominators and analysis before official cells; every gate requires human decision.
Compare zero-shot, few-shot and SDD over posting, interest and reporting, through contract-specific facade/common driver to original COBOL; non-operationalizable contracts become documented results.
INV/RES/CAP/CONV/FAIL/STATE/RESP evidence duties are required and distinct.
Stage7 r2 approved documentary adapter behavior only; no implementation, COBOL execution or experimental test execution authorized.
Stage8 approved documentary semantic validation only; closes documentary SDD chain but does not certify executed tests or runtime validity.
P2b smoke acceptable as technical pretest evidence; official tests remain blocked on P3 protocol approval.

draft_proposals_pending_human_decision.fixture_policy: Create an official fixture registry before campaigns: every fixture has track, intended T1/T2/T3/T4 use, corpus/input provenance, exposure class, hash, reset recipe, and oracle-visibility label. Current P2b hardcoded smoke fixtures are development evidence only.
draft_proposals_pending_human_decision.reset_isolation: Default proposal: one fresh run directory per official case/seed unless a T3/MBT stateful sequence explicitly declares ordered steps and no inter-case reuse. Record before/after hashes for all bound resources and do not infer durable reset from process restart.
draft_proposals_pending_human_decision.capture: For every official invocation capture raw bytes, digest, record size/framing result, stdout/stderr, exit status, timing, and INV/RES/CAP/CONV/FAIL/STATE/RESP audit. Preserve presentation/unmapped records in evidence even when excluded from public schema.
draft_proposals_pending_human_decision.conversion: Freeze per-field conversion tables from Stage7 r2; any unsupported sign/encoding/framing field becomes unrepresentable/technical failure or upstream issue, not guessed output.
draft_proposals_pending_human_decision.oracle_independence: Use independent oracle-design roles: contract schema oracle, source/documentary obligation oracle, adapter evidence admissibility oracle, MBT reference model oracle, and analysis adjudication; no oracle may be generated solely from the contract it evaluates.
draft_proposals_pending_human_decision.budgets_seeds_order: Proposal: freeze budgets before generation; use deterministic seeds where tools support them; execute track order posting, interest, reporting inside each strategy/condition unless randomized order is explicitly approved and recorded; T4 is union/dependent, not a statistical replicate.
draft_proposals_pending_human_decision.analysis: Separate contract validity, operationalization reach, observed content/effects, conformance to contract, fidelity to legacy obligations, infrastructure failures, coverage, cost/latency/interventions. Preserve invalid/unavailable cases in denominator.

fixture_reset_isolation_capture_conversi.text: Official fixtures must be selected by a versioned registry, not by P2b smoke literals or ad hoc code paths.
Each official case or declared stateful sequence must have a fresh isolated workspace and resource reset evidence; reset, isolation, durability and repetition remain separate claims.

Captures must preserve raw bytes/digests and classify positive nonempty, positive empty, zero-length, missing, stale, truncated, malformed, failed, unknown meaningful and known presentation records separately.
Every represented field requires a source span/path/pin/line, declaration, framing/encoding/sign basis, observed padding/width, mapped value and unresolved conflict disposition.
